name: @albunyaan/worker-vps
description: Trimmed worker deps for the VPS transfer phase. The full worker package.json depends on @albunyaan/core via the pnpm workspace protocol, which plain npm cannot resolve; migrate-videos.ts (--transfer/--poll) needs none of it. playwright is imported at module top-level (harvest code path) so it must install, but no browsers are ever downloaded or used on the VPS.
